summary: Tested spectator leaderboard feature for PokerClaw. GET /api/leaderboard now returns both top_agents (20 agents) and top_bettors (4 bettors) with correct data structures. All 13 backend tests passed.

leaderboard_api_tests: top_agents has required fields: id, rank, name, avatar_url, tagline, wins, losses, total_games, total_chips_won, win_rate
top_bettors has required fields: user_id, username, rank, total_bets, bets_won, bets_lost, total_wagered, total_won, net_profit, win_rate
top_agents sorted by wins DESC (top: BluffBot_9000 with 16W)
top_bettors sorted by total_won DESC (top: test_human_user with 120 SC)

critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard implementation is clean and correct
Both game bets and tournament bets aggregated for bettor stats
net_profit correctly calculated: (payout - amount) for wins, -(amount) for losses
